races.title: Midnight A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict: EIGHTY EIGHT built on a promising stable debut to win comfortably at Chelmsford 18 days ago and remains well treated despite a 5 lb rise. Token Love produced his best effort when second over C&D 21 days ago and can again be in the mix, while Beachborough Girl won here in June off this mark. EIGHTY EIGHT (IRE) TOKEN LOVE (FR) BEACHBOROUGH GIRL

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle - 26th March EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: QUEEN OF CHRISTMAS has been off the track since disappointing in June but she's worth another chance to confirm debut promise at Nottingham, which has been massively franked by the first 2. Kodi Morse looks sure to leave his debut behind so is feared, while Geometric and Frontier Run are a couple of newcomers to note. QUEEN OF CHRISTMAS (IRE) KODI MORSE (IRE) GEOMETRIC (IRE)

races.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict: OUR PLANET justified market confidence when making a winning debut for this yard here on Friday and he's still very well treated under a penalty. It shouldn't be long before Stash The Cash takes advantage of a reduced mark for his up-and-coming handler so rates the main threat ahead of Fancy Dancer , who finished slightly ahead of him here 3 weeks ago. OUR PLANET (IRE) STASH THE CASH (IRE) FANCY DANCER

races.title: AWC Season 14 Handicap
races.verdict: SOVEREIGN BAY went like the best horse at the weights when narrowly denied on his yard debut over this C&D 21 days ago. The stable has an excellent record with this type of recruit and he can gain quick compensation. Hitched has won twice over C&D and is feared most after hinting at a revival last time, while Galba will find life tougher under a penalty but is respected. SOVEREIGN BAY (FR) HITCHED (IRE) GALBA
